scopeNotes: Hospital + SNF ownership only in this package; Hospice and Home Health Agency ownership are out of scope (no existing KY/FL facility-name base table to scope against without a new CCN source) — documented boundary, not a silent omission.

Facility matching uses exact normalized-name matching only (no fuzzy matching, unlike OFR-02's crosswalk) since this feeds a program-integrity-adjacent goal category — coverage is a conservative lower bound, not exhaustive.

No live-sample re-fetch reconciliation check in this package (unlike OFR-01 through OFR-04): the underlying CMS datasets require paginated fetches (6500-row pages via offset), making a single-sample live re-verification comparatively costly relative to its incremental assurance value given the three structural/volume checks already in place. Recorded here explicitly rather than silently omitted.

rawPublisherFields: STATE - OWNER (owner's personal address state, not the facility's state)
privacyGuardrail.retainedInPsaOnly: full raw national CSV-derived JSON, content-hashed, per the person-level gate's PSA-retention allowance
privacyGuardrail.structuralEnforcement: dso_ownership_interest has no column for any of the fields above; CheckOwnershipNetworkNumbers additionally scans information_schema.columns for name/address/DOB/SSN-shaped column names and asserts zero matches
